checks.source: async()=>{await noetomeTab.playwright.getByRole('button',{name:'设置',exact:true}).click();const initial=await noetomeTab.playwright.evaluate(()=>({theme:document.documentElement.dataset.theme,alerts:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="alert"]')).map(x=>x.textContent)}));browserAssert(initial.theme==='light'&&initial.alerts.some(x=>x.includes('无法识别已保存的主题')),'Invalid preference was silently accepted');await noetomeTab.playwright.getByRole('button',{name:'切换到暗色',exact:true}).click();await noetomeTab.playwright.getByRole('combobox',{name:'主题',exact:true}).selectOption('light');await noetomeTab.getAXState();const restored=await noetomeTab.playwright.evaluate(()=>({theme:document.documentElement.dataset.theme,alerts:document.querySelectorAll('[role="alert"]').length,status:document.querySelector('.settings-status').textContent}));browserAssert(restored.theme==='light'&&restored.alerts===0&&restored.status.includes('已保存'),'Saving a valid preference did not recover');return {initial,restored};}

checks.name: Final dark inactive icon contrast
checks.source: async()=>{const r=await noetomeTab.playwright.evaluate(()=>{const icon=document.querySelector('.theme-toggle svg');const lum=c=>{const v=c.match(/[\d.]+/g).slice(0,3).map(x=>Number(x)/255).map(x=>x<=.04045?x/12.92:Math.pow((x+.055)/1.055,2.4));return v[0]*.2126+v[1]*.7152+v[2]*.0722};const foreground=getComputedStyle(icon).color,background=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).backgroundColor;const a=lum(foreground),b=lum(background);return {foreground,background,contrast:(Math.max(a,b)+.05)/(Math.min(a,b)+.05),theme:document.documentElement.dataset.theme};});browserAssert(r.theme==='dark'&&r.contrast>=3,'Dark inactive icon is unreadable');return r;}

checks.name: Final bright dark reload persistence and recovery
checks.source: async()=>{await noetomeTab.reload();await noetomeTab.playwright.getByRole('button',{name:'设置',exact:true}).click();const dark=await noetomeTab.playwright.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.theme==='dark'&&document.getElementById('appearance-theme').value==='dark');browserAssert(dark,'Dark theme was not persisted');await noetomeTab.playwright.getByRole('button',{name:'切换到亮色',exact:true}).click();await noetomeTab.reload();await noetomeTab.playwright.getByRole('button',{name:'设置',exact:true}).click();const light=await noetomeTab.playwright.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.theme==='light'&&document.getElementById('appearance-theme').value==='light'&&document.querySelectorAll('[role="alert"]').length===0);browserAssert(light,'Light theme or clean recovery was not persisted');return {dark,light,fixtureOverridesRemoved:true};}

checks.name: Final 640px long content and fixed bottom controls
checks.source: async()=>{await noetomeTab.playwright.locator('#main-content').press('PageDown');await noetomeTab.getAXState();const r=await noetomeTab.playwright.evaluate(()=>{const main=document.getElementById('main-content'),theme=document.querySelector('.theme-toggle').getBoundingClientRect(),settings=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="设置"]').getBoundingClientRect();return {width:innerWidth,overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,scrollTop:main.scrollTop,scrollHeight:main.scrollHeight,clientHeight:main.clientHeight,themeTop:theme.top,settingsTop:settings.top,settingsBottom:settings.bottom};});browserAssert(r.width===640&&!r.overflow&&r.scrollTop>0&&r.scrollHeight>r.clientHeight,'Long content scrolling is broken');browserAssert(r.themeTop<r.settingsTop&&r.settingsBottom<=600,'Bottom controls leave the viewport');return r;}

checks.name: Final normalized sidebar geometry
checks.source: async()=>{const r=await noetomeTab.playwright.evaluate(()=>({viewport:[innerWidth,innerHeight],railWidth:document.querySelector('.activity-rail').getBoundingClientRect().width,sidebarWidth:document.getElementById('app-sidebar').getBoundingClientRect().width,projectsTop:document.getElementById('projects-heading').getBoundingClientRect().top,themeTop:document.querySelector('.theme-toggle').getBoundingClientRect().top,settingsTop:document.querySelector('button[aria-label="设置"]').getBoundingClientRect().top,bodyOverflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,theme:document.documentElement.dataset.theme}));browserAssert(r.railWidth===52&&r.sidebarWidth===238&&r.themeTop<r.settingsTop&&!r.bodyOverflow&&r.theme==='light','Final sidebar geometry differs from accepted structure');return r;}
